# discord_color (Data Source)

Converts a hex or RGB color to the integer Discord uses for role and embed colors. On Terraform 1.8 and later, prefer the `provider::discord::color` function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# On Terraform 1.8 and later, prefer provider::discord::color().
data "discord_color" "blurple" {
  hex = "#5865F2"
}

data "discord_color" "green" {
  rgb = [87, 242, 135]
}

resource "discord_role" "blurple" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Blurple"
  color     = data.discord_color.blurple.color
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hex` (String) Hex color such as `#5865F2`, `5865f2` or `#fff`. Exactly one of `hex` or `rgb` is required.
- `rgb` (List of Number) Red, green and blue components, each 0-255, e.g. `[88, 101, 242]`.

### Read-Only

- `color` (Number) Color as an integer.
